headline: Gate E stochastic protocell ecology (Option B, dependency-free Gillespie SSA — NOT GillesPy2/COBRApy, which is og-36a): verdict=qualified. With the shared feed budget held EQUAL across arms, a cross-feeding community of 4 protocell lineages out-produces the BEST single lineage (community 1522 vs best-single 812 cumulative births; SSA margin 710, positive in 100% of seeds; margin_positive=True), and the margin is CAUSALLY cross-feeding: the knockout (cross-feeding off, same feed) collapses it to 11 (2% of the community margin; cross_feeding_causal=True). Coexistence is stabilised by depletable byproduct pools (negative frequency dependence), not assumed — deterministically all 4 lineages persist (n_alive=4), the knockout excludes down (2). BUT the benefit is productivity, not robustness: under low-count demographic noise the community is MORE variable than the rock-stable monoculture (cv 0.08 vs 0.04) and loses a lineage in 12% of runs (community_more_robust=False); the system-size sweep shows this divergence GROWING as counts fall (Omega 0.7: ext_frac 0.31, margin gap 0.20 vs Omega 4.0: 0.00/-0.01; stochastic_material=True) — the mean-field misses it. So qualified = a real, cross-feeding-caused community productivity win that low-count stochasticity makes FRAGILE. Unlike the pore (B), membrane (C) and energy carrier (35) — each of which buys persistence, NOT throughput — the cross-feeding ecology is the campaign's first genuine THROUGHPUT/productivity win (the community extracts more biomass from the same feed than the best single lineage, causally via cross-feeding); but it buys that productivity at the cost of ROBUSTNESS (more variable than a monoculture, lineage loss at low counts). The unifying campaign reading is not 'nothing buys throughput' but 'every mechanism trades one virtue for another — robustness/persistence is never free.' Metabolism = sustained A1 community, NOT autocatalytic (A2 refuted).
